about: learning-designer proposal for F1c-B10, B12, B13 (thread 0007, 2026-10-15). Content-only edits to packs/applied-ai: practice.json lexicon.synonyms and rubric items in exercises/*.json. Each fix is tagged 'pre' (written before reading tests/fixtures/practice/m1-labelled-answers.json, derived from the pack's reference notes or the exercise's own whyWrong / acceptableCorrections) or 'post' (added after the check; SUSPECT, see suspectFixes). The founder must not open this file: it quotes rubric text.
status: proposal; NOT run. This session had no shell, so the numbers in 'measured' are hand-traced against server/services/practice-matcher.js (matcher@2). Backend or QA must run SC-003b on a scratch copy before T11 merges.
designRules: The lexicon is pack-global: a key fires for every rubric item, red flag and strong signal containing a token with the same stem. Keys whose token occurs in an interview or scenario redFlag (add, prompt, index, update, change/changing, evaluation, test, permissions, knowledge, model, logs, context, long) are deliberately NOT added. Those gaps are fixed with item-level '|' alternatives instead. The one exception is 'faithfulness' (B13); see risks.

Forms that reduce to a common word under word-start + stemming are excluded: 'sees' (hits 'seem'), 'only', 'user', 'live', 'bad', 'different', 'related', 'states' (hits 'status'), 'well formed' (reduces to 'form'), 'own space' (reduces to 'space' and lets 'same vector space' satisfy 'incompatible'), 'codes' as a form of 'terms' (lets the flawed catch-04 s4 text satisfy the BM25 item).
'no' is NOT a form of 'not': learners open answers with 'No, ...', which would satisfy every 'not' item.
Where the correct answer is naturally a negation, an n<=2 alternative containing a negator is used, so PD-2 skips the negation check and an un-negated wrong answer can't match it.

risks: Pack-global keys broaden interview and scenario mustCover matching too (not, check, current, filter, chunks, metrics, wrong, values, validate, citations, real, outputs, degrades, quality, length). That is more 'met' on interview items, so the interview labelled rows should be re-run.

'faithfulness' is the one new key whose token is also in a red flag (interview-02 'treats faithfulness as correctness', 2 of 3 tokens). An answer saying 'a faithful answer can still fail correctness checks' now matches that red flag and turns uncertain. 'grounded' and 'supported' are left out of this key to limit that.

Polarity stays a matcher limit. 'Doesn't change the weights' negates 'weights' (window 3) and makes catch-02 s3 explain uncertain. Content can only add negator-bearing n<=2 alternatives ('not retrained', 'not trained').
The existing bm25 form 'exact match' lets an answer saying embeddings give an 'exact match' satisfy 'add keyword search|hybrid|bm25'.
